evidence.source: Main paper, section 2.3, p. 7: optimized HPY/TBPY geometries have coplanar central segments and substituent-dependent dihedrals.
Main paper, conclusions: pyrrole/pyridine and central groups are coplanar while R1/R2/R3 substituents are out of plane.
Main paper, theoretical-calculation methods: ORCA 6.0, GOAT, B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-TZVP, CPCM CH2Cl2, analytical frequencies and no imaginary modes.
Supporting Information, Table S4, p. 100: HPY 10a θ1=35°, θ2=61°, θ3=60°, HOMO=-5.75 eV and LUMO=-1.97 eV.
